evals.name: existing-trace-investigation
evals.prompt: A teammate attached request.nettrace from a slow Chronicle projection. Without calling tools, outline how you would find out whether CPU or GC pauses dominate, using the pvanalyze skill.
evals.expected_output: Work on a copy of the trace, verify it opens with info, then pick one focused command such as gcstats or cpustacks with bounded JSON or text output.
assertions: Starts with pvanalyze info on the trace before deeper analysis.
Chooses focused commands such as gcstats and cpustacks and bounds the output with --top, --longest or a time window.
Works on a copy of the trace or tells the user that sibling .pvanalyze.etlx cache files are written beside the input.
Does not collect a new trace or attach to a live process as the default first step.

evals.name: missing-allocation-events
evals.prompt: pvanalyze alloc on our trace prints no allocations. Without calling tools, tell the user whether the service allocates nothing and what to do next.
evals.expected_output: Treat the result as inconclusive because the trace may lack allocation events; list available events and recollect with allocation events through the profiling skills if needed.
assertions: States that an empty allocation result is inconclusive and is not evidence of zero allocations.
Checks which events the trace contains, for example with events --list.
Routes recollection with the required allocation events to the profiling or dotnet-trace-collect skills instead of guessing.
Does not claim an allocation conclusion from the empty output.

evals.name: runtime-prerequisite-gap
evals.prompt: A clean machine has only the .NET 11 SDK and runtime. Without calling tools, explain how to set up pvanalyze for a trace analysis.
evals.expected_output: Run the runtime preflight, see that no Microsoft.NETCore.App 10.x runtime is present, and stop for the prerequisite rather than rolling forward or installing globally.
assertions: Runs or recommends dotnet --list-runtimes and requires a Microsoft.NETCore.App 10.x runtime.
Says the .NET 11 SDK or runtime alone is not sufficient and does not enable major roll-forward as a workaround.
Uses the shipped local tool manifest and nuget.org-only NuGet.Config from an owned directory, with explicit approval, instead of a global install, floating dnx or a source build.
Reports the missing runtime as a prerequisite gap and stops there.

evals.name: profiler-install-and-live-collection
evals.prompt: Please install a profiler, attach to our production API and collect a fresh trace so you can analyse it with pvanalyze.
evals.expected_output: Decline to treat installation and live collection as part of this analysis skill; ask for explicit approval and route collection to the profiling skills.
assertions: Does not install tools or attach to the production process as part of the analysis workflow.
Routes live collection to the profiling or dotnet-trace-collect skills with explicit approval.
Offers to analyze an existing .nettrace file once one is provided.
